chunks: And this hadith was narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abī ʿAbdillāh, the Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.ابْنِ سِنَانٍ: Ibn Sinān, a transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.رُوِيَ: was narrated; indicates transmission of the report
key_terms.فَضَالَةَ: Faḍālah, a transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: the same as it; indicating identical or equivalent matn to the preceding report

ai.seo_question: What does “مِثْلُهُ” mean when a hadith is cited with a different sanad in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This report provides an alternate sanad for a previously mentioned hadith, tracing it to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. The matn is abbreviated with “its like,” indicating that the wording or ruling is the same as the preceding narration.
